text:
incidents-bot: PAGER: High GPU queue growth in prod (region us-west-2). Autoscaler failing to add GPU nodes. Error rate increasing; some requests returning 503s. Pager escalated to on-call. @alice_oncall please triage. :rotating_light:

alice_oncall: taking it. Thanks. Any immediate customer reports?

raj_prod: yes, I’m seeing spike in inference request latency for /v1/generate — ~30% 5xx from a handful of customers. Filing a ticket per our incident runbook.

matt_sre: I’m looking at cluster-autoscaler logs. Seeing repeated failures when creating nodegroup: "AttachRolePolicy: The request was rejected because the policy arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/AttachInstanceProfile is not attachable" and also "InvalidLaunchTemplateId.NotFound" for a subset of AZs.

sanam_infra: that looks like two separate issues: (1) an IAM role/policy attach restriction, (2) launch template mismatch across ASGs. Could be a provisioning race where recent LT version rolled forward but ASG config still references older version.

alice_oncall: can someone paste the exact autoscaler error?

matt_sre: here are the relevant lines from autoscaler (tail):

```
E0423 14:14:02.123456 1 scale_up.go:420] Failed to provision: failed to create nodegroup: InvalidLaunchTemplateId.NotFound: The launch template 'lt-0a1b2c3d4e' does not exist
	status code: 400, request id: 111-222
E0423 14:14:05.789012 1 scale_up.go:436] Failed to scale up: error creating instance: AccessDenied: User: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/cluster-autoscaler-role is not authorized to perform: iam:PassRole on resource: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/EC2InstanceRole
```

alice_oncall: ok both are actionable. Matt — can you confirm which nodegroups are failing (names)?

matt_sre: failing for nodegroup-gpu-a and nodegroup-gpu-b. Nodegroup-gpu-a shows LT id mismatch; nodegroup-gpu-b shows iam:PassRole denied.

jess_devex: linking runbook for GPU autoscaling: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-autoscale. Steps: (1) check ASG->LT versions, (2) validate instance profile attach policy, (3) fallback plan: create temporary nodegroup with known-good LT and proper instance profile.

alice_oncall: appetite for fallback? If we can stand up a manual nodegroup quickly, that will relieve queue. Who can create?

sanam_infra: I can create a temporary ASG+LT in us-west-2; will need a confirm on instance profile name to attach. Which profile?

matt_sre: use the existing EC2InstanceRole-prod (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/EC2InstanceRole) — but that’s the one failing PassRole. Check the role trust and attach permissions. I suspect the cluster-autoscaler role lost the iam:PassRole permission in the recent IAM policy cleanup.

alice_oncall: raj, can you surface which customers are impacted and if we need immediate mitigation message?

raj_prod: customer tickets reporting increased errors; SLA alerts triggered for two enterprise customers. I'll open a status page incident and flag SRE/infra doing mitigation. ETA for customer-facing note: 10m.

matt_sre: quick check: can anyone run this to reproduce the PassRole error?

```
aws iam simulate-principal-policy --policy-source-arn arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/cluster-autoscaler-role --action-names iam:PassRole --resource-arns arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/EC2InstanceRole
```

Results show Deny. So cluster-autoscaler role missing iam:PassRole for that resource.

sanam_infra: ok we need two parallel actions: (A) fix IAM (add iam:PassRole to cluster-autoscaler role) — low blast but requires IAM approval; (B) create temporary manual nodegroup using a different instance profile that already works for autoscaling (or use infra-managed service role). Which is faster?

alice_oncall: which option unblocks capacity fastest?

sanam_infra: creating a manual nodegroup with an instance profile that does not require cluster-autoscaler to pass a role (i.e., create nodes with a user-data bootstrap that uses an existing profile) will be fastest. I'll spin up a nodegroup with a baked AMI and attach instance profile: EC2InstanceRole-legacy which has no new restrictions.

matt_sre: we should also patch the cluster-autoscaler to use older launch template version for nodegroup-gpu-a until LT issues are resolved. That is lower impact.

alice_oncall: go for both in parallel. Sanam — create the manual nodegroup and post the ASG name. Matt — patch autoscaler config to pin LT version. Raj — status page. Jess — runbook steps and coordinate change window. I'll be the bridge to leadership.

sanam_infra: creating now. Command I’m running (short):

```
aws autoscaling create-auto-scaling-group \
  --auto-scaling-group-name temp-gpus-1745 \
  --launch-template LaunchTemplateId=lt-0knowngood,Version=1 \
  --min-size 0 --max-size 10 --desired-capacity 3 \
  --vpc-zone-identifier \"subnet-abc,subnet-def\"
```

I'll post updates when instances are InService.

deploy-bot: Noting: no user app deploys allowed while we have ongoing infra changes per deploy freeze policy. :no_entry:

matt_sre: pinning LT version in cluster-autoscaler config: editing CA deployment to add --node-group-auto-discovery-annotation=... and forcing version=1 for nodegroup-gpu-a. Patch applied, restarting pod.

alice_oncall: any rollback risk?

matt_sre: low — this is a config pin to prevent the CA from requesting the non-existent LT id. Should be safe.

ops-bot: Reminder: open an IAM change request for adding iam:PassRole to cluster-autoscaler-role (CR-1745).

raj_prod: status page draft posted: "We are investigating elevated error rates for the inference API in us-west-2. Engineers are working on autoscaler and provisioning issues; temporary mitigation in progress." (link to status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1745)

sanam_infra: temp-gpus-1745 instances are InService and nodes registered with k8s. Kube shows 3 new gpu nodes: gpu-temp-1/2/3 (ready). Draining queue now.

matt_sre: autoscaler restarted, now seeing fewer scale errors. Queue length for GPU jobs trending down.

alice_oncall: do we have metrics to confirm customer impact reduced?

raj_prod: error rate down from 30% 5xx -> 6% 5xx in last 7m. Latency p50 back to normal; p95 improved. I’ll update customers.

alice_oncall: Great. Next steps: (1) complete IAM CR to restore iam:PassRole — priority high, (2) reconcile launch template versions across ASGs and remove mismatches, (3) roll temp nodegroup into proper infra or tear down after we validate stability, (4) postmortem with timeline and RCA. Assign owners?

sanam_infra: I'll own temp nodegroup lifecycle and LT reconciliation.

matt_sre: I’ll own cluster-autoscaler policy and add tests to catch LT drift and missing iam:PassRole in CI.

jess_devex: I’ll start a postmortem doc and capture runbook gaps.

alice_oncall: excellent. Final checkin: system stabilized, CPU/GPU queues draining. Leaving this thread open for CR/IAM completion and postmortem. :white_check_mark:

incidents-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Degraded -> Mitigated at 14:31 UTC. Root cause: a combination of launch template version mismatch and missing iam:PassRole permission on cluster-autoscaler role causing multiple scale-up failures. Temporary manual nodegroup provisioned to relieve customer impact.

alice_oncall: closing here once IAM CR merged and LT reconciliation done. Thanks team.
